semantics.authoritative_for: revisable research assumptions and decision-needed defaults

target_compute.statement: The final research model should run on the documented Lenovo laptop.
target_compute.review_trigger: A different deployment target or approved compute budget is chosen.

service_cost.statement: Prefer free or already-available research services; paid services require an explicit adoption decision.
service_cost.review_trigger: A paid source materially improves evidence quality and its cost/licensing are approved.

retail_access.statement: Any eventual execution instrument should be accessible to a Norwegian private retail investor.
retail_access.review_trigger: Execution scope, jurisdiction, or account type changes.

initial_market_scope.statement: Initial research scope is CME Henry Hub natural gas futures only.
initial_market_scope.review_trigger: Natural-gas research reaches a stable comparison point or scope is explicitly expanded.

canonical_market_provider.statement: No expiry-aware canonical futures provider is approved yet; raw per-contract data remains the required evidence shape.
canonical_market_provider.review_trigger: A candidate passes source, licensing, cost, expiry, settlement, and provenance review.

continuous_series_policy.statement: Raw per-contract rows are canonical; continuous series are derived artifacts and must not contaminate cross-contract returns.
continuous_series_policy.review_trigger: A deterministic roll policy is pre-registered and validated against canonical contract history.

forecast_target_priority.statement: Volatility plus settlement direction is the preferred next serious experiment; the next-session-return bootstrap remains unchanged for comparison.
forecast_target_priority.review_trigger: Out-of-sample evidence or target economics justify a different primary target.

weather_archive.statement: Actually-issued historical forecasts are required; Open-Meteo historical forecasts are the low-friction candidate and NOAA GFS/GEFS is the heavier fallback.
weather_archive.review_trigger: Coverage, licensing, timestamp fidelity, or reproducibility is inadequate.

broker_candidate.statement: Saxo SIM is a verification candidate only; broker choice must remain replaceable and is not part of forecast-model authority.
broker_candidate.review_trigger: Instrument availability, costs, API quality, or retail eligibility are verified across candidates.
